name: Skykomish River (Big Eddy – Monroe)
blurb: The Sky below the Gold Bar whitewater — big, clear water and gravel bars on the way to Sultan and Monroe.

sections.notes: Put in river left below the Hwy 2 bridge. Big river with real current; wood on the outside of bends. Big Eddy is a State Parks-managed access (per WDFW): Discover Pass required. Sultan take-out fee status not confirmed.

notices.title: Locate the Sultan River access before launching
notices.text: Sportsman Park is on the Sultan River near its Skykomish confluence. The Area marker is the inland park location, not the take-out eddy. Scout the river approach during the shuttle; no connecting shoreline route is mapped. No overnight parking.

putInAccess.operator: Washington State Parks and Recreation Commission (per WDFW)
putInAccess.sourceName: WDFW Facilities GIS, Hand Launch layer (ObjectID 27)
putInAccess.note: Batch 3. Coordinate is WDFW's own hand-launch feature. Esri World Imagery (z19, checked 2026-10-25, research/raw/batch3/bigeddy.png) puts it about 3 m from the water's edge under trees. Legal access: WDFW Big Eddy page (https://wdfw.wa.gov/places-to-go/water-access-sites/big-eddy-617) says 'Access area open: Year-round Managed by Washington State Parks', no boat ramps, 1 hand launch, 1 parking lot, 1 restroom; WaterAccessSites layer (https://geodataservices.wdfw.wa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/WP_RealEstate/WaterAccessSites/FeatureServer/1) lists manager State Parks, no closure. Hand-carry only. Discover Pass required. State Parks' Boat Launches layer has no Big Eddy feature, so the coordinate rests on WDFW.
putInAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHDPlus HR flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
putInAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream, the hand launch is left of the NHD centreline (~23 m). Confirmed on imagery.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: City of Sultan — Sultan Sportsman Park
takeOutAccess.note: The city facility page confirms river access and publishes this park coordinate. City Ordinance 1430-26 separately identifies the parking area and boat launch and prohibits overnight parking. Imagery confirms the park northeast of the confluence. Exact shoreline access under the bridges and trees remains unverified; do not substitute the industrial property across the Sultan River.
takeOutAccess.directions: Enter Sportsman Park from Albion Street at US 2. The park is on the Sultan River just upstream of its Skykomish confluence. Identify the boat access and the confluence during your shuttle; the Area marker is inland, not the take-out eddy.

sections.notes: Take out river right below the Lewis Street bridge — concrete ramp, restrooms. Discover Pass required at Lewis Street (WDFW).

takeOutAccess.operator: Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife
takeOutAccess.sourceName: WDFW Facilities GIS, Boat Ramp layer (feature 143, concrete)
takeOutAccess.note: Batch 2. Coordinate is WDFW's own boat-ramp feature. Esri World Imagery (z19, checked 2026-10-25, research/raw/batch2/lewisst.png) puts it at the water's edge east of the lot by the Lewis Street bridge. Legal access: WDFW Lewis Street page (https://wdfw.wa.gov/places-to-go/water-access-sites/lewis-street-616) lists 1 concrete ramp, open year-round; WaterAccessSites layer (https://geodataservices.wdfw.wa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/WP_RealEstate/WaterAccessSites/FeatureServer/1) shows WDFW-managed, no closure. Pass required.

takeOutAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~234), the ramp is right of the NHD centreline. Confirmed on imagery.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
